status: proposed; owner approval required before formal roots or matches

time.control: equal per-move allowance; untimed native MatchRecord
time.meaning: Each engine receives go movetime 500 only. Natural early finish and own time-management policy are retained. Not equal completed depth/nodes or guaranteed identical actual CPU use.

resources.hardware: Same Apple M1 Pro/32GiB macOS27 host; sequential games, one search thread per engine, no pondering
resources.mshogi: Frozen conventional/classical engine, internal4096-entry TT, no external book/model/tablebases
resources.memory: Modest native cache policies are recorded, not claimed byte-equal: mShogi4096 TT entries vs Stockfish16MB Hash plus embedded98.5MB NNUE. No swapping/large memory handicap intended. Stockfish defaults remain full strength.

population.selection: Independent draws with replacement; six authored orthodox opening families, uniform native legal4..8-ply continuations; reject nonlive/claimable/material imbalance>100cp and fixed12 old development prefixes. Family/length held fixed during rejection. Not a tournament-book or all-Chess population. No candidate/Stockfish evaluation filter. Duplicate draws retained.
population.seed: Fresh OS-random32-byte seed generated once after protocol/build/code freeze and explicit approval; no rerolls
population.pairing: For each draw run adjacent two games, mShogi White then Black; preserve complete orthodox-start native prefix.

stopping.budget_includes: All routine smoke and formal active match invocation wall time, failed attempts and bounded cleanup. No parallel invocations. CPU billing is not measured; sequential1-search-thread engines keep compute of same order as elapsed. Setup/build/replay/review excluded. No paid compute or third-party fees.
stopping.admission: Stop new pairs when less than600s remain; hard outer process-group deadline at remaining allowance, with at most5s reap overhead recorded. Preserve partial artifacts/unscored interruption. No automatic budget extension or replacement pair.
stopping.failure: Stop on first invalid/incomplete formal pair; retain all failures/caps/cleanup/stderr/diagnostic evidence. No reruns on unchanged source to select favorable results. No early stop based on score, no per-technique study.

analysis.score: W/D/L and mShogi score fraction over32 games; 16 paired scores (win+halfdraw)/2 are sampling units
analysis.uncertainty: For complete eligible16-pair sample only, two-sided95% Hoeffding interval for mean pair score: mean +/- sqrt(log(40)/(2*16)), clipped[0,1]. Broad interval; assumes independent sampled roots/stable conditions. No binomial32-independent-games assumption, no Elo conversion. Incomplete study has descriptive observed counts only, no acceptance inference.
analysis.acceptance_proposal: Accept a complete, reproducible, independently reviewed measurement/report, regardless of observed score. No numerical release-strength bar or parity/human-Elo claim. A decisive loss is reported honestly; further engineering belongs in separately scoped work.
